We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 UI/UX Designer (m/f/d) Your role

You own how fonio feels on the web. Our website is our most important storefront - and right now it's not where it needs to be. You don't build one nice page, you build a system: a design system and landing page templates that roll out into localized pages across 9+ markets. Continuous optimization, not a one-off redesign. You design and ship - you own the build end-to-end, not a handoff to engineering. We're building an AI operating system for SMBs - people should feel that on the website.

What to expect

 * You own the design and continuous optimization of our website and landing pages

 * You build a scalable design system with reusable components

 * You develop landing page templates that localize across all markets (DACH, FR, IT, ES, UK, PL, US, and more)

 * You design and ship live yourself - full ownership from concept to published page

 * You think in user journey, conversion, and responsive design

 * You work closely with the Creative Director on brand direction

Who we're looking for

 * Several years of experience as a UI/UX or web designer focused on converting websites (portfolio required)

 * You think in systems and components, not individual pages

 * You build and ship yourself

 * Experience with design systems and localization across multiple markets

 * You understand conversion and think in journeys

 * German + good English

What we offer

 * Competitive salary: €65,000-€90,000

 * Equity - you're building this, so you should own a piece of it.

 * Food & drinks - lunch and dinner are on us at the Vienna office (plus all the drinks you want, and yes, we have protein bars and vitamins too).

 * Relocation bonus (if you still need to move to Vienna)

 * Equipment of your choice - whatever makes you happy.

 * Regular team offsites.

Hiring process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 20 min culture fit with the founders

1 Technical GEO Growth Specialist (f/m/d) - full-time Own our GEO strategy

The goal is to make Walls.io the primary source AI engines actually cite for social media feeds, social APIs, UGC, and event marketing. You'll create E-E-A-T-driven content to build our brand presence and topical authority across LLMs and track our brand's share of voice.

Search and AI visibility don't stop at our own site. Where it moves the needle, you can build presence on platforms that shape both organic discovery and how LLMs perceive us: YouTube as a search engine in its own right and Reddit or LinkedIn strategies that feed brand authority and GEO. You decide which channels are worth the effort.

Run GEO growth experiments

Every month, you'll propose, launch, and test a mini project outside your day-to-day: a new channel, content format, tool, or tactic, with success criteria defined upfront and measured throughout.

Manage SEO

Your day-to-day work covers a wide range of SEO topics, from discovering new search terms and building links to updating existing content and conducting regular technical SEO audits.

Automate

You automate before you're asked to. Audits, keyword research, competitor tracking, and reporting run on scripts, AI agents, or workflows you built, not manual pulls from GSC, Ahrefs, or PostHog every week.

What success looks like

In your first 3 months, you've set baselines and launched your first experiments. Over the following quarter, qualified signups and demo requests from organic channels are trending clearly upward, our LLM share of voice is climbing against competitors, and your core reporting and audits run automatically instead of by hand.

Requirements
Who you are

 * Experience: minimum 4 years of experience in SEO, preferably within SaaS. You understand how LLM-generated answers work.
 * Proven track record: Experience in increasing organic traffic and generating business for a SaaS product.
 * Skills: Strong communication skills. Exceptional written and spoken English. Technical background so you can read HTML/CSS/JS, reason about crawlability, publish mini websites independently, and write technical specs for developers when needed.
 * You use AI every day. You've used tools like Claude or ChatGPT way beyond the chatbox. You already automate tasks like reporting, data analysis, audits, and content creation, focusing on outstanding results, no slop.
 * Initiative is at the heart of this role. You must proactively identify opportunities or challenges and take action to address them without waiting for direction. We're looking for a test-and-learn mindset.

Our offer
You will work in a centrally located office with a lot of natural light and space in a renovated factory building. There's a fully equipped kitchen with big dining tables, sound-proofed phone/video call booths, meeting and focus rooms, and a relaxation area.

 * A collaborative and supportive international team that values open communication and teamwork.
 * Hybrid work: A balance of home and office days
 * Personal budget for education, conferences, literature, ...
 * Free public transport card for Vienna's excellent network
 * Fun team activities
 * An inclusive work environment that fosters professional growth and development
 * Full access to paid AI tooling: Claude, ChatGPT, whatever you need
 * Company 100% owned by the original founder

Additional Information

 * Position: Full-time (38.5 hours/week) based in Vienna.
 * Salary: Based on your qualifications and experience, we offer a salary between EUR 55,000 and 70,000 gross annually (split over 14 salaries/year).
 * Start Date: Flexible

Hiring timeline

jobs.description:
To Recruitment Agencies:

Allianz SE has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz SE does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firm recruiters.

When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place. Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz.

Please do not contact hiring managers directly.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Who will you join?

GCL (Group Center of Competence Life) drives the Life business within the Allianz Group through a combination of strategy development and hands-on business initiatives. LIT (Life Internationalization team) is one out of five units in GCL, focusing on

- a group-wide program to further develop our unit-linked business in terms of volume (assets under management) and the share of wallet of the assets managers belonging to the Group
- productivity levers in Life (in collaboration with H4/Az Tech), e.g. by digital customer journeys and a Life IT strategy which reflects the needs of the respective business models
- influence distribution and incentive patterns to help achieve our strategic ambitions in Life
sustainability-related topics which are specific to Life business

How can you make an impact?

- Drive the successful (co-)development, improvement and implementation of new concepts and solutions together with the relevant stakeholders all over the Group
- Participate in research and fact finding as a solid fundament for the elements of our strategy, challenging the status quo and working closely with other GCL teams and a variety of stakeholders in planning, structuring and steering projects and initiatives
- Prepare presentations, status reports and business reviews
Prepare and facilitate business network and community meetings, including documentation and follow-up

What are you made of?

- University degree in mathematics, business studies/economics, finance or related subjects
- Professional experience in an operational Life or related entity, thereof at least two years in an Allianz OE
- Solid knowledge and experience in preferably two of the following areas: Life Products/Actuarial, investment or asset management, Sales & Distribution, Finance, IT/Operations
- Passion for numbers, in combination with smart communication of complex topics to a broader audience
- Fluent in English and at least one other business language of relevance in the Group
- Project management capabilities and ability to independently manage communities
- Entrepreneurial, resilient mindset, collaborative and enthusiastic
- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus
- Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solution

Do we have what you need?

- Flexible and hybrid work model
- Multinational and inclusive community
- Great career development and learning opportunities
- Company pension and health insurance
- Employee stock purchase program with a discount
- Health and well-being offerings
- Supportive family care benefits
- Opportunity to contribute to our sustainability programs
- Great place to work certified

And there is much more: Allianz SE Benefits

To learn about our recruitment process: Allianz SE Recruitment Process
Apply before: 9 October- Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis and we reserve the right to withdraw the posting prior to the advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
